1.text: Nuko rero niba mwarazuranywe na Kristo, mujye mushaka ibiri hejuru aho Kristo ari, yicaye iburyo bw'Imana.

2.text: Mujye muhoza umutima ku biri hejuru atari ku biri mu si,

3.text: kuko mwapfuye kandi ubugingo bwanyu bukaba bwarahishanywe na Kristo mu Mana.

4.text: Kandi ubwo Kristo ari we bugingo bwacu azerekanwa, namwe muzaherako mwerekananwe na we muri mu bwiza.

5.text: Nuko noneho mwice ingeso zanyu z'iby'isi: gusambana no gukora ibiteye isoni, no kurigira no kurarikira, n'imyifurize yose ari yo gusenga ibigirwamana,

6.text: ibyo ni byo bizanira umujinya w'Imana abatumvira.

7.text: Kandi namwe mwabigenderagamo kera, ubwo mwahoraga muri byo.

8.text: Ariko none mwiyambure ibi byose: umujinya n'uburakari, n'igomwa no gutukana, kandi ntihakagire amagambo ateye isoni aturuka mu kanwa kanyu.

9.text: Ntimukabeshyane ubwo mwiyambuye umuntu wa kera n'imirimo ye,

10.text: mukambara umushya uhindurirwa mushya kugira ngo agire ubwenge, kandi ngo ase n'ishusho y'Iyamuremye.

11.text: Aho ntihaba Umugiriki cyangwa Umuyuda, uwakebwe cyangwa utakebwe, cyangwa umunyeshyanga rigawa cyangwa Umusikuti, cyangwa imbata cyangwa uw'umudendezo, ahubwo Kristo ni byose kandi ari muri bose.

12.text: Nuko nk'uko bikwiriye intore z'Imana zera kandi zikundwa, mwambare umutima w'imbabazi n'ineza, no kwicisha bugufi n'ubugwaneza no kwihangana,

13.text: mwihanganirana kandi mubabarirana ibyaha, uko umuntu agize icyo apfa n'undi. Nk'uko Umwami wacu yabababariye, abe ari ko namwe mubabarirana.

14.text: Ariko ibigeretse kuri ibyo byose mwambare urukundo, kuko ari rwo murunga wo gutungana rwose.

15.text: Mureke amahoro ya Kristo atwarire mu mitima yanyu, ayo mwahamagariwe kuba umubiri umwe, kandi mugire imitima ishima.

16.text: Ijambo rya Kristo ribe muri mwe rigwiriye rifite ubwenge bwose, mwigishanye, muhugurane muri zaburi n'indirimbo n'ibihimbano by'umwuka, muririmbirirana Imana ishimwe mu mitima yanyu.

17.text: Kandi icyo muzavuga cyose n'ibyo muzakora, mujye mubikora byose mu izina ry'Umwami Yesu, mushima Imana Data wa twese ku bw'uwo.

18.text: Bagore, mugandukire abagabo banyu nk'uko bikwiriye abari mu Mwami wacu.

19.text: Bagabo, namwe mukunde abagore banyu ntimubasharirire.

20.text: Bana, mwumvire ababyeyi banyu muri byose, kuko ibyo ari byo Umwami ashima.

21.text: Ba se, ntimukarakaze abana banyu batazinukwa.

22.text: Mbata, mwumvire ba shobuja bo ku mubiri muri byose, ntimubakorere bakibareba gusa ngo muse n'abanezeza abantu, ahubwo mubakorere mutaryarya mu mitima yanyu mwubaha Imana.

23.text: Ibyo mukora byose mubikore mubikuye ku mutima, nk'abakorera Shobuja mukuru badakorera abantu,

24.text: muzi yuko muzagororerwa na we muhawe wa murage, kuko mukorera Shobuja mukuru Kristo.

25.text: Ariko ukiranirwa aziturwa nk'uko yakiraniwe, kandi ntihariho kurobanurwa ku butoni.
